title: O365 stub DID doc lists org revocation key as verificationMethod
description: profiles/o365-employer-did.md §3.1-3.2: org key as a verificationMethod in each user's DID document lets the org sign as the user. Remove; org authority is provisionerSig on document updates (spec §2.4.4, §2.5.7). Related agora-pozi.6 (non-impersonation).
